Specimen.title: Material Specimen Record
Specimen.description: Represents an analyzed physical material specimen, its classification, physical properties, circular economy pathways, and photograph reference.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of when the specimen was analyzed or documented

imageUrl.description: Reference URL or data URI for the examined specimen photograph

identification.description: Primary material identification and classification data

sustainability.description: Life cycle, circularity, recyclability, and longevity ratings

redesign.description: Repair restoration, practical reuse, and reimagine concepts

designInsight.description: Industrial design historical context and non-destructive verification guidance

/specimens/{specimenId}.description: Shared real-time collection of all documented material specimens visible to all users across devices.
